subject: 2020 Commencement Exercises
overview: Medford Vocational Technical High School convened for its 2020 Commencement Exercises, featuring opening remarks and the Pledge of Allegiance.

items.title: Pledge of Allegiance and Opening Remarks
items.summary: Paul D'Alleva opened the ceremony, and Elijah Fortune led the Pledge of Allegiance and delivered brief remarks to the graduating class.
